deliverables.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished CHARACTER DESIGN CONCEPT BOARD for the bathroom cashier / water-card recharge attendant in an existing 2D Chinese old factory/prison game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: existing game's warehouse-clerk sprite sheet. Follow its exact hand-drawn cartoon character language: dark crisp contour lines, expressive large head, compact short adult body, rounded shoes, simple flat cel-shaded color masses, around 2.7 heads tall, warm skin. Do not copy that woman's identity or make painterly photorealistic facial texture. Input image 2 is the BATHROOM ENVIRONMENT REFERENCE ONLY: grey-blue/aqua tiles, ivory trim and modest old factory materials. Neither input is an edit target.
Character: one middle-aged male public-bathroom attendant, stocky compact build, slightly receding short dark hair with a few grey strands, thick eyebrows, small tidy moustache, a practical observant expression with a hint of warmth. Wearing a faded grey-blue short work jacket with sleeves rolled over a warm beige shirt, a short brown canvas waist apron with a small ledger/pen pocket, dark charcoal trousers and worn dark cloth work shoes. Very modest brass keyring at waist. No peaked police cap, no orange prisoner uniform, no white doctor coat, no military insignia, no weapon. Distinct occupation readable from workwear, apron and water-card gesture.
Composition: clean wide landscape art board on warm off-white paper, sparse fine blue-grey section separators; high legibility, no noisy grain. LEFT HALF: large full-body neutral idle pose at an elevated game-compatible three-quarter angle, facing slightly screen-right, relaxed hands, complete shoes. RIGHT HALF: the SAME man in two smaller full-body action studies side-by-side, same identity/clothes/body proportions: one counts a few coins and marks a small ledger, the other hands a small muted teal-blue rectangular water card toward a customer just off-frame. No second person. Bottom narrow strip: enlarged face/expression study and a close detail of apron/pen/keys, plus a tiny same-character game-scale thumbnail to demonstrate readable silhouette. All figures fully clothed.
Use very few readable Chinese labels, exact heading "浴室收费员", pose labels "待机" "收款登记" "递交水卡". No invented personal name, prices or gameplay statistics. Illustration first, notes secondary. The main figure should dominate and feel ready to adapt into the existing sprite pipeline, not a realistic man or a 3D toy. Crisp linework and clean edges even in the small thumbnail, subdued palette coordinated with the bathroom. No building scene, HUD, buttons, logos or watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished GAME PROP AND PLACEMENT CONCEPT BOARD for prepaid water-card bathing in an existing 2D old Chinese factory/prison game.
Input image 1 is the EXISTING BATHROOM LAYOUT AND ART reference: six shower bays in two banks, central passage, four-door changing locker southwest, wood bench and linen basket southeast, ivory/grey-blue tiled architecture. Image 2 is the APPROVED CASHIER CHARACTER reference: exactly that stocky middle-aged moustached man with grey-blue work jacket, beige shirt, brown short waist apron, dark trousers/shoes, chibi linework. These are references, not edit targets. Keep cashier identity and existing orange-uniform player consistent.
Composition: wide landscape design board, warm off-white paper, restrained grey-blue dividers and headings. TWO balanced main rows. TOP ROW is object exploration with three generous clear panels; BOTTOM ROW is one integrated orthographic elevated game-scene view plus a small simple interaction strip. Clean crisp high quality, objects occupy the canvas prominently, no clutter or gritty noise.
TOP LEFT (about40%): "水卡" — large front and back of ONE muted teal/grey-blue rounded plastic prepaid card, recognizable bank-card size, a modest cream label, printed water-drop symbol, exact front text "公共浴室" and "水卡". Sparse small card-number marks on reverse, tasteful worn corners, a small metallic contact/chip detail and a matching drop emblem. Same proportions in both views, no brand, no fixed money amounts. One smaller inventory-size version below, clean silhouette readable at game size.
TOP MIDDLE (about30%): "充值台" — compact old wooden-top grey-blue painted metal service counter, just about one human torso wide, small locked cash drawer, a modest desktop water-card recharge reader with slanted dark face, tiny amber monochrome screen and a clear water-drop contact pad. A thin ledger, pen and a few coins on the tabletop, a small cream enamel label reading exactly "水卡充值". All textures match the game's worn factory hand-painted props, fine outlined edges, localized restrained wear. No huge kiosk, computer tower, futuristic neon touchscreen or busy wiring. At most one additional small close-up of its desktop reader.
TOP RIGHT (about30%): "刷卡用水" — small splash-resistant grey-blue metal shower-side card reader/control box, simple rounded rectangular case, four screws, one recessed water-drop-marked card contact pad, one small amber/green status lamp and a simple control button. Mounted on a little sample of the same aqua shower tile and existing aged steel pipe/valve; show one card tapping the pad. Exact small label "刷卡用水". Practical old factory utility hardware rather than sci-fi technology.
BOTTOM integrated scene: heading "入口右侧收费点". Show the SAME bathroom from the reference at a perfectly axis-aligned orthographic elevated TOP-DOWN 2D game camera, full room or a generous lower-half view that includes the southern doorway, the southwest lockers, at least the lowest two showers and the southeast service spot. NOT an isometric diamond or photographic render. In the marked southeast changing area, replace the old bench's service footprint with the compact recharge counter against the RIGHT side, the approved male cashier standing immediately behind it, face visible above counter, actual character scale equal to the existing orange prisoner around84 world units tall. Keep counter and cashier completely to the right of the central north-south walking aisle. One fully clothed familiar spiky black-haired orange-uniform prisoner stands in front/left of the recharge counter handing over the same small teal water card. Keep south entrance and centre aisle clear. Retain the linen basket tucked into the southeast wall edge and the four lockers on the left. Preserve thin ivory coping, grey-blue trim, aqua wall tiles, grey-blue floor proportions and tiled doorway style. Put a tiny shower-side card reader on each of the two visible showers, mounted to its service pipe wall, small enough not to overwhelm the shower. Do not add a new room or change the building footprint. No red annotation box in output.
At the very bottom, a discreet three-step conceptual strip with three small illustrative icons and exact labels "充值水卡" → "刷卡扣费" → "开启淋浴". Convey the prepaid-card flow clearly, without specifying a price or duration. Avoid game HUD, giant instructional UI, action buttons, prices, invented personal names, logo, watermark, naked bathers, photorealistic people, modern luxury spa materials. Props can be slightly more painterly than the cartoon character, matching existing game material language. This is a final visual concept review board, not a software UI implementation.
